description: Send the next message in a task once get_task says it is not running: answer its question (an option or your own words) or ask for a revision. Or, in place of a message, pass another_ai for another model to write its own version of the latest reply, kept beside it in the app. Returns the same task_id; poll get_task again.

another_ai.description: true for the next lab this task has not heard from, or a name from list_models with kind writer, only when your human named one ("GPT"). Works on a reply made with a skill.

doc_ids.description: Docs, presentations or storyboards the task must read (ids from get_task, list_space or create_doc).

files.description: file_id values from sending files to upload_file urls.

name: reply
title: Reply to task
